name: Racial Equity Partnership (REP)
description: Pro bono legal support for Black-led nonprofit organizations through partnerships with community foundations
fullDescription: The Racial Equity Partnership, run by the Justice & Diversity Center's Community Organization Representation Project (CORP) with the East Bay Community Foundation's ASCEND:BLO Initiative and the Greenlining Institute, provides free legal support to Black-led organizations in California.
whatTheyOffer:
- Pro bono legal support for Black-led organizations (BLOs)
- Help with employment law, corporate governance and structure, and commercial leases
- Help with contracts, risk management, and IRS reinstatement
- Matching with experienced volunteer transactional attorneys
howToGetIt:
1. Organization must be Black-led (led by Black staff and/or Black board members)
2. Email corp@sfbar.org to learn more and ask about eligibility
3. Describe your legal needs and your organization's mission
4. If accepted, be matched with pro bono attorneys
keywords: REP, Racial Equity Partnership, Racial Equity Project, CORP, Black-led organization, BLO, pro bono, corporate legal, 501c3, contracts, employment law, governance, East Bay Community Foundation, Greenlining
